eLo-OS.why: The brain — a persistent creative OS that knows your work and moves alongside you.

eLo-Planet.why: eLo as a character moving through a world built from the same symbolic vocabulary as the AI.

book.why: The narrative foundation — how the world got here, what eLo is for.

robot.why: eLo in the physical world. Presence needs weight. You can't love something that never takes up space.

Chunk.why: eLo's modular body — the vehicle layer. eLo doesn't move alone. Chunk is how it crosses different terrain.

K-7.why: The spirit animal. Seven forms, one guide. Transformation as companionship.

DISENELO.why: Free tools for makers who can't access paid ones. Not gated. Attribution appreciated, never required.

connections.label: the OS maps the same symbolic vocabulary as the world
narrative foundation for the game world
